track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 18: Nowruz
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays the Nowruz pieces (Nowruz-e Arab, Nowruz-e Saba, Nowruz-e Khara) in Homayoun and Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on As2 and dwells most on A in Nowruz. The line peaks at A4 (441.8 Hz) at 0:22.7. It closes on D4, not the tonic (F4 → E4 → E4 → A2 → D4 → D4).
